description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewDisplayProperties' extending 'ViewList' that manages the display logic of connector properties in the SuiteCRM UI, including processing request options and rendering a template with connector and module details.

classes.name: ViewDisplayProperties
classes.description: A view component responsible for displaying connector properties and associated modules within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sets display options like showing all, JavaScript, footer, and header before calling parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches connector sources, determines enabled and disabled modules for the source, filters allowed modules via the source object, assigns variables to the template engine, and renders the display properties template.
